city.prompt:
Create a complete polished 16:9 Chinese architectural 3D dashboard DESIGN ASSET, target 1920x1080, not a software screenshot. One whole screen, crisp readable Chinese UI. Shared design system: left content rail 27% width with warm off-white background fading smoothly into the 3D scene; dark navy title 高新区数字楼宇; subtitle 武汉 · 光谷; teal pill badge; thin teal section rules; restrained teal #087f85, navy #093342, cream #f6f5ef, blue-grey glass, muted bronze fins, olive planting. Neutral soft daylight with mild warm reflections, no golden sunset or glowing gold facades. Architectural detail is realistic and buildable. Keep UI typography, KPI card sizing and pictogram language consistent. KPI icons MUST be the original reference's bold FILLED teal pictograms: building silhouette with white windows; three stacked filled diamond plates; circular pie-sector glyph with small muted bronze segment; solid group-of-people silhouette. No thin outline substitute, no trend arrow for occupancy. Category icons: bold teal code brackets, filled CPU with pins, filled briefcase; services filled group, rounded parking P tile, filled bus. Global navigation appears ONLY at top-right as one white rounded pill containing 区域总览 / 园区总览 / 重点楼宇, selected tab filled teal. No duplicate bottom tab bar. No oversized decorative HUD or blue sci-fi theme. Data is explicitly fictional demo. All eight building identities remain A1,A2,B1,B2,B3,C1,C2,C3. A1: rectangular blue-grey glass tower with exactly three terraced podium storeys, 21 tower storeys above (24 total), muted bronze vertical fins on right side, inset planted roof; do not change silhouette between views. No company claims, watermarks or unreadable extra text.
Input1 is the EDIT TARGET for CITY overview, preserve its lake-city geography, irregular highlighted district and relative industrial campus location. Input2 is supporting style/UI/icon/architecture reference from the companion campus design; follow its exact left rail typography, filled icons, daylight, glass and bronze A1 identity. Header badge 区域概念 · 演示方案. Layout: heading 区域总览 with subline 东湖高新区产业空间; section 产业方向 with three equal white icon tiles 软件研发, 光电子信息, 企业服务 using bold filled teal icons. Lower left section 重点园区 contains polished card 光谷示范园区 > and 2x2 metrics: building icon 8栋 楼宇数; layer icon 24万㎡ 建筑面积; pie glyph 84% 出租率; people icon 216家 入驻企业; broad teal CTA 进入园区 >. Do NOT add an industry percentage chart to city panel: city has categorical directions, campus has industry composition. Top-right global pill active 区域总览, next 园区总览 and 重点楼宇, same position and visual as input2. Main scene covers all remaining screen edge-to-edge, continuous detailed city with natural irregular blue lakes, islands, tree-lined believable roads, bridges only on explicit crossings, varied midrise/tall buildings and no regular grid roads entering lakes. Highlight one irregular district with a precise THIN solid cyan-blue contour (2–3px apparent width), narrow light inner edging and gentle broad soft cyan shadow (NOT a thick white neon rope). Tint interior a subtle translucent sage-green. Entire large SOUTHERN/BOTTOM lake and its irregular full shoreline must be INSIDE the highlighted boundary; line runs on land outside the complete water body, never bisects or cuts the bottom lake. Highlight the demonstration neighborhood around the central small campus using a distinct translucent pale warm-gold land tint and slim gold border, retaining a legible teal campus perimeter. Small campus must use the exact eight-building companion model, A1 bronze-finned tower and three terraced podiums. Point labels: 产业楼宇 (neutral marker left), 配套服务 (neutral marker right), 光谷示范园区 with a compact white/teal 进入园区 > card and warm-gold map pin. Avoid overlap between point cards, boundary and global navigation. Lower-right compact legend 区域示意 (cyan outline circle), 示范园区 (muted gold dot). Small disclaimer bottom edge 区域轮廓、路网与点位为概念示意，非测绘成果. Preserve a sophisticated understated daylight architectural miniature look across district scale, not a flat GIS screenshot, rectangular floating tile, dark sci-fi map or artificial toy grid. One full 16:9 city dashboard design asset.
